subject: Order Designating the Minister of State (Sport) as the Minister for the Purposes of the Physical Activity and Sport Act
precis: Order (1) repealing P.C. 2025-494 of May 13, 2025; (2) designating the Minister of State (Sport), a member of the King’s Privy Council for Canada, as the Minister for the purposes of that Act.
